mapper.sql: SELECT m.*, COALESCE(v.note, '') AS note, COALESCE(v.note_version, 0) AS note_version, v.deleted_at, CASE WHEN m.origin='GENERATED' THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_asset older WHERE older.work_id=m.work_id AND older.origin='GENERATED' AND (older.created_at<m.created_at OR (older.created_at=m.created_at AND older.id<=m.id)) ) ELSE NULL END AS version_number, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM section_edit e WHERE e.task_id=m.generation_task_id) AS section_edit FROM media_asset m LEFT JOIN media_asset_annotation v ON v.asset_id=m.id
mapper.select: WHERE m.work_id=#{work} AND v.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 100
